items.q: Can I book or pay on this website?
items.a: No. The website shows our packages. Every trip is planned with you on WhatsApp, and we share payment details only after you approve your final quote.
Prices are starting prices per person. Your final quote depends on dates, hotel choice, flight fares and group size, and we send it on WhatsApp.

items.q: Can you help with my visa?
items.a: Yes. We give you a document checklist, book your appointment where needed and review your application before you submit it.

items.q: Can you plan a trip to a country that is not listed?
items.a: Yes. We plan trips to any country. Send us your destination, dates and budget and we will build a custom trip.

items.q: What is usually included in a package?
items.a: Most packages include return flights from Lagos, hotels with breakfast, airport transfers and the tours in the itinerary. Each package page lists what is and is not included.
Six to eight weeks ahead is ideal, and longer for Europe, the UK and the US because of visa timelines. Short-notice trips are possible for many destinations.
